judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A clearly good sky photo with a striking textured cloud sheet, though the light and foreground keep it from being outstanding.
strengths: Vivid blue sky with good contrast
Sky occupies a strong portion of the composition
weaknesses: Lighting is fairly flat and midday-like
Foreground trees are somewhat dark and ordinary
Cloud pattern is pleasant but not especially dramatic
